fusions.name: Tamping Blow
fusions.desc: Brings the flat of the blade down for 18 damage, stuns the target for 1.4 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Levelled Ground
fusions.desc: Slams the ground flat, dealing 34 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Rammed Earth
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Post-Driver's Count
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. When it reaches 5, they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
